title: Love Your Customers: Building Loyalty in the Sign Industry
description: Joe and Liz share practical strategies for building long-term customer loyalty in a project-based industry, from handwritten thank-you cards to vetting client relationships.
keyTakeaways: Handwritten thank-you cards create lasting impressions
Swag boxes and small gifts show appreciation
A company motto helps align team behavior with values
Not every customer is worth keeping — learn to vet relationships
Consistent follow-up turns one-time buyers into repeat clients
